scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared-esm,shared-cjs,cli,server,client -c yellow,yellow,magenta,blue,green "pnpm --filter @unleashd/shared watch:esm" "pnpm --filter @unleashd/shared watch:cjs" "pnpm --dir vendor/agent-cli-tool watch" "pnpm --filter @unleashd/server dev" "pnpm --filter @unleashd/client dev"
scripts.dev:server: pnpm --filter @unleashd/shared build && pnpm --dir vendor/agent-cli-tool build && pnpm --filter @unleashd/server dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @unleashd/shared build && pnpm --dir vendor/agent-cli-tool build && pnpm --filter @unleashd/server build && pnpm --filter @unleashd/client build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @unleashd/shared build && pnpm --filter @unleashd/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @unleashd/client exec tsc -b && pnpm --dir vendor/agent-cli-tool typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test:server && pnpm test:client:buddy && pnpm test:cli && pnpm test:package && pnpm test:api
